the flapping wing is a very efficient propulsion method, and that the flapping frequency is the most important parameter for the propulsive efficiency.
we have shown that the flapping motion of a flexible plate in the wake of a bluff body can be a very efficient propulsion mechanism.

the optimal heave velocity is a non-trivial function of the Reynolds number and the reduced frequency, and it cannot be obtained simply by maximizing a lift-drag ratio.
